name: asc-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for the App Store Connect API. Lets Claude Code prepare, submit, and release your App Store versions.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: The Issuer ID shown in App Store Connect under Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API

key_id.title: Key ID
key_id.description: The Key ID of your API key on the same page. Put the private key at ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/AuthKey_<Key ID>.p8
